name: Habits on Reminders
subtitle: Habit tracker on top of Reminders and calendar widgets

apps.name: Habits
apps.subtitle: Habits on Reminders & Calendar Enhancer
apps.localizedDescription: Habit tracker that takes completions from Reminders, with habit grid and goal widgets, plus calendar widgets and alert notifications for calendar events.

versions.localizedDescription: New light and dark app icon (follows the system theme). Habit names show in their colors, and page titles shrink into the bar smoothly. Export a habit as an image (Export Image… on its page) and import days into a habit from a CSV. "Count twice days as 2" now sits under Twice a day and applies everywhere. The habit grid draws only the weeks you see, so scrolling is smoother. Partially done days can be shown as a dot. Calendar widget settings are grouped into Light and Dark, with a dark background color and gradient option, and hour lines under events are dimmer.

The app is now called Habits on the Home Screen. Page titles shrink smoothly into the bar when you scroll. Calendar widget colors match Apple's Calendar (darker titles in light mode, denser events and a darker background in dark mode). Backups are now four clear files (habit settings, a table of days, habit names, app settings) with earlier copies in a backups folder. An alert added to an event that already started today notifies right away. New habits start with Why Not Done off.

Each habit now has one skip rule — Missed Days or Weekly Goal (with an option to count twice days as 2) — and question marks show only on days that break it. Habit settings are grouped into three cards. CSV export is now two tables (habits and days, with notes and skip reasons). Widgets use the same round checkbox as the main screen, the main screen's today mark has a size setting, and banners fold back on a second tap.

The calendar widget's alert bell now sits in the event's top-right corner and fits even half-hour events; its size and distance from the edges are adjustable in Calendar settings. Banners show up to two lines — tap one to read the whole message, swipe it up to close.
Banners can be round or squircle again (Settings → Banner), and while a banner shows nothing peeks out above it. The widget's round checkbox shows an outlined check, and a filled cross once done.
Removes leftover habit reminders from older versions that could still arrive; the app now only sends calendar event notifications.

New Not Done style in settings: a lighter fill, an outline or any icon such as a cross or a dot. Main screen can show the round checkbox again (Settings → Main Screen). Opening a day's menu no longer leaves a white trace on missed days, the question mark is outlined cleanly, and banners get a soft blur behind them.

Today's day replaces the checkboxes: on the main screen each habit shows today's cell with the same marks and menu as its grid, and widgets show it as their button (the round checkbox is still available in settings). Why Not Done is now a per-habit switch: question marks on not-done days without a reason, and a Long Gap banner with tips instead of notifications. Missed days sit on a continuous band, notes and question marks have their own corners, and new defaults: a day ends at 3:00.

Page titles no longer disappear during or after pull to refresh, and a short title appears in the bar when you scroll. Banners stay 10 seconds (tap or swipe up to close), sit beside the back button and their width is adjustable in settings. The same-reason alert is marked 「Long Gap」 with a question mark in the habit's color. Marking a day earlier than the first one keeps the grid in place and adds the half year before it.

Why Not Done: hold a not-done day to pick a reason (or add a new one). Days without a reason get a question mark, and when one reason repeats several days in a row a notification suggests how to change the habit (prompt, ability or motivation, after Tiny Habits). Reasons are managed in Habits on Reminders Settings → Why Not Done.
Pull to refresh shows what was updated; the main title moves into the bar when scrolled instead of disappearing; leaving the last habit from Archive or Trash returns to the main screen.
The alert bell now fades together with the event when the event continues into the previous or next column.
Short calendar events (under 30 minutes) are shown as half-hour slots; alert bell color settings for light and dark themes; main title raised; red icon for Stop Backing Up.

Fixes: backup folder, CSV import and restore from backup pickers now work; calendar events align exactly with hour lines and short events shrink their title instead of growing; version shown at the bottom of the main page.

Backups (with iCloud folder), CSV import, trash, merge, missed days, Twice a day refinements, app icon picker, alerts for events moved earlier, and many settings refinements. See the commit history for details.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: The widget shows today's calendar events.
privacy.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Completed reminders are added to your habit history.
